children.value: > Fact From Story: In a TikTok posted by Francesca on Thursday 5 October, the father-daughter duo appeared on camera while the legendary director’s daughter explained that she was going to quiz him on popular internet slang.
> > Fact From Story: Since it was posted on Thursday, Francesca’s video of her father guessing popular slang terms has been viewed one million times on TikTok.
> > > Fact From Story: The first - and arguably most important - internet slang word that Francesca quizzed her father on was “tea”, as she gave the example: “I’m going to spill the tea.”

> > > Fact From Story: Not only were people in the comments section shocked to see the legendary director on their screens, but they were also stunned that he managed to guess many of the terms correctly.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Quizzing someone involves asking them questions.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Videos that are viewed on TikTok are posted on TikTok.
> Commonsense Knowledge: People often post videos of themselves doing things on TikTok.
